unresolved_or_conflicting_conditions: Four IFC model files are licensed under GPLv3 (projects/4351, ettenheim_gis, hitos, samuel_macalister_sample_house).
Redistributing the whole folder as a single package would impose GPLv3 copyleft obligations on those models, conflicting with the CC BY 4.0 dataset licence.
West Riverside Hospital model is CC BY 3.0, which is not the same as the dataset's CC BY 4.0.
notes: Permissions above apply to the dataset's own CC BY 4.0 content; model files must be tracked individually.
